entries.title: Isaiah 23:1
segments: The burden against Tyre: Howl, ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:2
segments: Be still, inhabitants of the coast, merchant of Sidon, who pass over the sea. They have filled you.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:3
segments: And by great waters, the seed of Sihor and the harvest of the river Nile [was] her revenue; and she a mart of nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:4
segments: Be ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the strength of the sea, saying, I have not travailed nor brought forth. I have not nourished young men [nor] raised up virgins.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:5
segments: As the report comes to Egypt, [so] they shall be grieved at the report of Tyre.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:6
segments: Pass over Tarshish. Howl, inhabitants of the coast!

entries.title: Isaiah 23:7
segments: [Is] this your joyous [city] from days of her old age? Her own feet carry it afar off to stay.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:8
segments: Who has purposed this against Tyre, the crowning [city], whose merchants are rulers, whose merchants are the weighty of the earth?

entries.title: Isaiah 23:9
segments: The LORD of hosts has purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory [and] to bring into contempt all the weighty of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:10
segments: Pass through your land like a river, O daughter of Tarshish; [there is] no more strength.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:11
segments: He stretched out His hand over the sea; He shook kingdoms. The LORD has made a decree against the merchant [city], to destroy its forts.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:12
segments: And He said, You shall rejoice no more, O crushed one, virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Chittim; also there you shall have no rest.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:13
segments: Behold the land of the Chaldeans! This people did not exist. Assyria founded it for those who live in the desert. They set up their siege-towers; they stripped its palaces. They made it a ruin.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:14
segments: Howl, ships of Tarshish! For your strength is laid waste.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:15
segments: And in that day Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. At the end of seventy years, it will be as the song of a harlot to Tyre.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:16
segments: Take a harp, go about the city, O harlot who has been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs so that you may be remembered.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:17
segments: And it will be, after the end of seventy years the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 23:18
segments: And her goods and her wages shall be holiness to the LORD. It shall not be treasured nor laid up, for her goods shall be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat enough, and for a choice covering.
